title: Who Was Shanta?

claims.claim: Srimad Bhagavatam: to his friend Romapada, Dasharatha gave his own daughter Shanta, whom Rishyashringa married

claims.claim: Anga suffers a drought under King Lomapada; the Brahmins say: bring Rishyashringa and give him the maiden Shanta
claims.quote_sa: प्रयच्छ कन्यां शान्तां वै विधिना सुसमाहितः ॥

claims.claim: Rain falls as Rishyashringa arrives; the king of Anga gives him Shanta in marriage; he lives there with his wife Shanta
Sanatkumara's prophecy: Dasharatha will be friends with the king of Anga, and HE will have a daughter named Shanta
claims.quote_sa: अङ्गराजेन सख्यं च तस्य राज्ञो भविष्यति । कन्या चास्य महाभागा शान्ता नाम भविष्यति ॥

claims.claim: In the prophecy Dasharatha tells Lomapada: I am childless; may Shanta's husband perform my rite
claims.quote_sa: अनपत्यो ऽस्मि धर्मात्मञ् शान्ताभर्ता मम क्रतुम् ।

claims.claim: Dasharatha to Lomapada: let your daughter Shanta come to my city with her husband
claims.quote_sa: शान्ता तव सुता राजन् सह भर्त्रा विशाम्पते । मदीयं नगरं यातु कार्यं हि महदुद्यतम् ॥

claims.claim: The women of Ayodhya's inner palace welcome Shanta; she stays; after the horse-sacrifice she leaves with Rishyashringa; then Rama is born
Nowhere in the CE is Shanta called Dasharatha's daughter or Rama's sister (she is named only in 1.8-10 and 1.17)

shots.en: Did Rama have a sister named Shanta?

shots.hi: वाल्मीकि रामायण, बाल कांड, सर्ग दस। शान्ता तव सुता राजन् सह भर्त्रा विशाम्पते । मदीयं नगरं यातु कार्यं हि महदुद्यतम् ॥ ये है असली कहानी।

lines: शान्ता तव सुता राजन् सह भर्त्रा विशाम्पते ।
मदीयं नगरं यातु कार्यं हि महदुद्यतम् ॥
sloka.en: “O king, lord of the people, let your daughter Shanta come to my city with her husband, for a great task is at hand.”
sloka.translit: śāntā tava sutā rājan saha bhartrā viśāmpate, madīyaṃ nagaraṃ yātu kāryaṃ hi mahadudyatam

shots.hi: एक प्रसिद्ध कथा कहती है: शांता, राजा दशरथ की बेटी थीं, श्रीराम की बड़ी बहन।

quote.en: “To Romapada, his friend Dasharatha gave his own daughter, Shanta.”

shots.en: In Anga, under King Lomapada, a terrible drought fell. The Brahmins said: bring the sage Rishyashringa, and give him the maiden Shanta in marriage.

verify_note: Whole CE searched: Shanta named only in 1.8.16, 1.8.21, 1.9.31-32, 1.10.3, 1.10.5, 1.10.19, 1.17.5. 1.10.3 'कन्या चास्य' = the Anga king's daughter; 1.10.19 Dasharatha: 'शान्ता तव सुता' (your daughter). 1.10.5 (inside Sanatkumara's prophecy told by Sumantra) Dasharatha: 'अनपत्यो ऽस्मि' I am childless. Popular: Bhagavata 9.23.7-8 (vedabase.io): Dasharatha gave his own daughter Shanta to Romapada. Research: series/untold-ramayana/research/A82_shanta.md
caption: Many of us heard that Rama had an elder sister, Shanta, given by King Dasharatha to his friend, the king of Anga. The Srimad Bhagavatam tells it that way. In Valmiki's Ramayana (Critical Edition), Shanta is the daughter of Lomapada, king of Anga, and the wife of the sage Rishyashringa. The prophecy says the king of Anga "will have a daughter named Shanta", and Dasharatha himself says to Lomapada: "Let YOUR daughter Shanta come to my city with her husband." Both tellings are told with devotion.
